value.rationale: A canonical symmetric cubic configuration graph exhibits two simultaneous nonzero positive homology degrees at the intermediate Rips stage, a subsequent seven-sphere jump, and distinct group-invariant behavior in those two degrees. Exact integral homotopy and quotient persistence distinguish natural invariants that a first-graph homology or Rips Betti-only table cannot establish. The focused finite case is inherently motivated, not an arbitrary unstructured parameter test.
